welcome: Welcome to Northwind Cloud. I am glad you are here.
You lead the account team of ten that takes every client from first call to signed contract.
This quarter I need the number, and I need clients who still trust us when it is in. You will not always be able to have both.
product: We sell a data platform that finance teams use to close their books faster.
Every deal moves through five stages: Prospect, Discover, Demo, Propose and Close.
targets: Reach $240,000 in new revenue over eight weeks.
Watch the budget, customer trust and product quality on your board: your choices move them.
A burned out team will not hold the number next quarter.
Three people outside your team matter too: Priya at Halcyon Retail, Helen in finance and Elena in delivery.

stages.name: Prospect
stages.about: Finds companies that fit and books first calls, so the pipeline never runs dry.
stages.suits: Research, energy for outreach and resilience after a no.

stages.name: Discover
stages.about: Learns what each client is trying to fix and whether the platform can fix it.
stages.suits: Good questions, careful listening and sound judgment.

stages.name: Demo
stages.about: Shows the platform working on the client's own problem.
stages.suits: Product knowledge, clear storytelling and attention to detail.

stages.name: Propose
stages.about: Works through price, terms and the client's objections.
stages.suits: Composure, persuasion and knowing where the limits are.

stages.name: Close
stages.about: Signs the contract and hands the client to onboarding with a clean promise.
stages.suits: Follow through, relationships and keeping promises.

variables.name: Budget
variables.about: What you can spend this quarter beyond salaries: training, team events, contractors and hires.

variables.name: Customer trust
variables.about: How much your clients trust Northwind to keep its promises. It counts in your Business score.

variables.name: Product quality
variables.about: How well what the team delivers works for clients. It slips a little each week without care.

variables.name: Reputation
variables.about: What the market says about Northwind. You do not see it, but prospects do.

stakeholders.name: Priya Shah
stakeholders.role: Head of Finance Operations, Halcyon Retail
stakeholders.about: Leads Halcyon Retail's account, Northwind's largest client. She chose the platform and her reputation rides on the go live.
stakeholders.hiddenConcern: Her own CFO has asked her to look at Cirrus Systems if the go live slips again.
stakeholders.concernLine: Honestly, my CFO has asked me to get a quote from Cirrus. I do not want to, but I need this go live to land.

npc.motivatedBy: A go live her finance team can rely on, and not being surprised.

interactions.label: Meet Priya
interactions.goal: Hear what Priya needs from the account team, and agree what happens next.

interactions.label: Email Priya an update
interactions.goal: Write Priya a clear update on the go live: where it stands, what is next and when.

interactions.label: Negotiate the go live scope
interactions.goal: Agree with Priya what goes live first and what follows, so the date holds without burning the team.

stakeholders.name: Helen Brandt
stakeholders.about: Owns Northwind's budget. Generous with teams that show her the numbers early, hard on those that surprise her.
stakeholders.hiddenConcern: The board wants a 10% cost cut next quarter and she has not told the business yet.
stakeholders.concernLine: Between us, the board is pushing for cuts next quarter. I need to know where the money actually works.

npc.motivatedBy: Forecasts she can trust, and money that shows a return.

interactions.label: Present the forecast
interactions.goal: Brief Helen on the quarter: the numbers, the biggest risk and what you need.

options.label: Ask for $20,000 for a contractor this quarter
options.detail: She says yes to teams she trusts.

effect.outcome: Helen releases the money: a contractor joins for the go live.

otherwise.outcome: Helen says no: show her the numbers first.

options.label: Hold off until the numbers improve

effect.outcome: You keep the ask for later.

stakeholders.name: Elena Ruiz
stakeholders.about: Runs the engineers who integrate and launch what your team sells. Her team is stretched across every client.

interactions.goal: Agree with Elena what your team sells and what hers can deliver.

interactions.label: Negotiate priorities
